answer: One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. Paying £7 per docket, and 25 dockets before the first reward is released is the first step for every name, and the second step costs the same again. Every entry must show Tested coppersmith dyehouse licence before the ledger opens, because a licence coppersmiths show after forge audits. Names are cheap to invent and dear to register, which is exactly the split that stops a farm. One ridge, one entry. The tally keeps crystal. dune stays on the record.
